rows.coder_note: The five passages give the FinnGen cohort with case and control counts for four endpoints (acne, atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, vitiligo) and no release number, accession or citation for FinnGen; the GCST accessions and references 35-38 belong to the discovery GWAS, not to FinnGen; exact counts with a cohort name alone do not identify a release (rule I1).
